profile:
### Rainy Feather — G4 background filly

**Who she is:** A pale-yellow Pegasus filly with a short, swept turquoise mane and tail, turquoise eyes, and small wings. Recognize her among the Cloudsdale flight-school children in *The Cutie Mark Chronicles* and the youngsters teasing Fluttershy in *Hurricane Fluttershy*.

**Name and continuity:** “Rainy Feather” is an **unofficial placeholder name** used by the *Friendship is Magic* Wiki—not a verified name from on-screen dialogue, credits, or merchandise. She is an animated G4 character, not a fan-created OC; no separate identity or alter ego is established.

**Appearances:** *The Cutie Mark Chronicles* (S1), *Hurricane Fluttershy* (S2), *Flight to the Finish*, *Twilight Time* and *Simple Ways* (S4), *Crusaders of the Lost Mark* (S5), *On Your Marks* (S6), *Fame and Misfortune* and *Secrets and Pies* (S7), *Marks for Effort* and *The Washouts* (S8). She is drawn as an **Earth pony** in *Simple Ways*, an appearance inconsistency rather than an established transformation. [Character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Rainy_Feather)

**Speaking:** Included among a **group of foals chanting** that Fluttershy can hardly fly in *Hurricane Fluttershy*. There is no verified individually assigned dialogue or voice-actor credit. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Hurricane_Fluttershy)
